Garciloga es una plataforma de formación: Garciloga is a role-based professional training platform: processes, cases, tools and decisions, from the first steps to supervision, management and executive roles.
Impulsar el crecimiento profesional de l: To drive people's professional growth through training that is practical, accessible and focused on the real world of work.
En Garciloga ayudamos a desarrollar cono: At Garciloga we help people build the knowledge, skills and competencies to perform with confidence in different roles, from their first professional steps to leadership and executive positions.
Combinamos aprendizaje estructurado, sit: We combine structured learning, real situations, decision-making, tools and applied projects to turn knowledge into abilities that can be demonstrated.
Construir una plataforma educativa donde: To build a learning platform where anyone can discover their potential, develop new skills and advance professionally without limits set by where they started.
Aspiramos a transformar la manera en que: We aim to change how people and organizations develop talent, connecting learning with the real challenges of work and offering growth paths that are clear, flexible and competency-based.
Queremos que aprender, mejorar y prepara: We want learning, improving and preparing for new responsibilities to be an ongoing opportunity.
Garciloga nació de una idea sencilla: ap: Garciloga was born from a simple idea: learning should prepare us to face real situations, not only to pass exams.
El proyecto fue creado en Ciudad de Méxi: The project was created in Mexico City by Isaac López García, drawing on his professional experience in technology companies, Customer Success, Onboarding, Account Management and customer service.
Inicialmente comenzó como CodeZero, una: It first began as CodeZero, a platform designed to teach programming from scratch.
Durante su evolución surgió una visión m: As it evolved, a broader vision emerged: people need more than technical tools; they also need to understand processes, solve problems, communicate, make decisions and build the competencies required to grow professionally.
Así nació Garciloga como una propuesta d: That is how Garciloga came to be: a comprehensive approach to training for work.
Hoy, el proyecto busca conectar el conoc: Today the project seeks to connect knowledge with practice through career paths, exercises, work scenarios, projects and tools so that people and teams can identify their strengths and opportunities to improve.
Nuestra historia está comenzando y quere: Our story is just beginning, and we want to build a platform that evolves alongside the people who learn on it.
